profileEvidence.author: A
profileEvidence.summary: Intelligent, friendly and strong-willed, Basset Griffon Vendéens share a scent-hunting tradition shaped by hunting on foot. The label covers two distinct breeds, Grand and Petit. The Grand is often calm and considered in company, while the Petit is lively and courageous; both retain a keen interest in trails and rough cover.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: Grand and Petit form a French scent-hound family with independent minds, shared pack-hunting roots and a keen interest in trails.
